text: Wahoo Fitness, majority-owned by Rhône Group from June 2021 and taken over by its lenders in early 2023, was bought back in May 2023 by founder Chip Hawkins together with three 'equal strategic partners' (Rhône Group, Jory Capital's David Wichmann, and RZC Investments), leaving the company debt-free.
short: Founder Chip Hawkins and three private partners bought Wahoo Fitness back in May 2023.

source.name: DC Rainmaker: Wahoo Fitness Founder Buys Company Back from Banks (Ray Maker)
source.quote: Chip himself, alongside three "equal strategic partners", have bought back the business. There is no longer any debt remaining
source.note: The article names the three partners as Rhone Group, David Wichmann of Jory Capital, and RZC Investments; it also describes Rhone Equity's majority purchase of June 2021.
